text:
maria: heads-up - support ticket: customer saw two toolcall charges after a truncated stream + instant retry. ledger shows provisional + final both present.
oscar: can you paste the minimal repro?
maria: summary: client streamed, server sent a truncation FIN at ~token 980. client retried immediately. router sent the retry to a different regional shard (failover). tool executed again. ledger: provisional_charge followed by confirmed_charge.
jin: is session id preserved? if yes, should dedupe.
maria: client kept X-Session: atlas-3f but router affinity changed due to shard health. dedupe cache is local -> miss.
billing-bot: INFO billing: provisional(session=atlas-3f,id=pc_f12,tokens=980)
support-bot: Ticket #8251 created for customer. trace_id=tr_0a1b2
billing-bot: INFO billing: confirmed(session=atlas-3f,id=cc_e77,tokens=978)
sara: UI shows both charges (no refund). that's bad UX. we need either auto-refund or clear provisional state.
oscar: quick mitigations: 1) mark provisional entries with a distinct color and helptext; 2) add a one-click "request refund" that opens ops flow.
jin: architecture discussion: options = global dedupe index (sync) or routing sticky window for reconnects. global index is expensive and complicates scaling.
maria: what if router includes X-Prev-Shard header when reconnecting, then the new shard checks prev shard for dedupe via an async probe or short RPC?
oscar: we already have an inter-shard RPC plane for health - could piggyback a lightweight dedupe lookup: key = session + toolcall-hash. if hit, respond "DUP" and skip double execution.
jin: careful with latency. this check must be bounded (e.g., 50ms) and optional fallback to normal execution. otherwise we'll harm P99.
billing-bot: NOTE billing: provisional entries are flagged reconciled=false until ledger confirms.
sara: console change + runbook: show reconciled=false -> support should wait 2-5m for reconciliation before refund unless explicit customer complaint. add an ops shortcut to force refund if needed.
maria: implementation proposal: 1) router: attach X-Prev-Shard on reconnects within N seconds. 2) target shard: on incoming request with X-Prev-Shard, fire a best-effort dedupe probe to prev shard. if prev returns DUP, short-circuit. else continue. 3) metric: provisional_vs_confirmed_by_route and alert when delta spikes. 4) console: provisional badge + refund action.
jin: agree. add a canary: enable for 10% traffic for 24h then roll. need e2e test that simulates truncated FIN + immediate retry to a different shard.
oscar: added note: sticky-window should be tunable per-customer; for enterprise customers we may want longer to avoid double-charge during mobile reconnections.
maria: I'll file infra ticket INF-4512 with logs, traces, and the suggested plan. tagging billing + routing + support.
billing-bot: ACTION billing: requested ledger team to expose reconciliation webhook for provisional -> confirmed events.
sara: once webhook exists, console can update rows in near-real-time and hide provisional duplicates automatically.
maria: thanks everyone. follow-ups: INF-4512, add dashboard tile for provisional delta, and support runbook update.
jin: one more thing - document the tradeoff in routing SLO doc: cross-shard dedupe vs failover availability. we need product signoff.
oscar: noted. opening a short PRD stub. :thumbsup:
